description: This file contains shell functions and script logic for managing pull request (PR) workflows, including resolving PR repository URLs, pushing changes via GraphQL, verifying PR head branches, setting up remotes, and handling push retries with fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: resolve_head_push_url
methods.description: Resolves the push URL for the PR head repository, using environment variables and fallback to URL formatting.

methods.name: graphql_push_to_fork
methods.description: Pushes commit diffs to a GitHub fork via GraphQL mutation, handling large files and file types carefully.

methods.name: resolve_head_push_url_https
methods.description: Resolves the HTTPS clone URL for the PR head repository.

methods.name: verify_pr_head_branch_matches_expected
methods.description: Verifies that the PR's head branch matches the expected branch name.

methods.name: setup_prhead_remote
methods.description: Configures a 'prhead' remote pointing to the PR's head repository URL.

methods.name: resolve_prhead_remote_sha
methods.description: Resolves the SHA of the remote PR head branch, with fallback to HTTPS URL if needed.

methods.name: push_prep_head_to_pr_branch
methods.description: Handles pushing local changes to the PR branch, including lease management, retries, fallback via GraphQL, and SHA verification.
